people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

people.name: Succoth
people.line: City in Canaan, location of Solomon's bronze works

translations.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
translations.bsb: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
translations.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
translations.asv: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
